I kept wondering, in the four places: Wind, earth, water, fire... where is he staying?} {align:justify|Next I recited a mantra, the general meaning being: "If I can find it in the microscopic world, in the water world, in all the hidden bodies of the subtle world, wherever there is... then please manifest!"...} {align:justify|But the result is still empty!} {align:justify|I know clearly the summoning power of this Secret Mantra, because In the dharma of transcending summoning, the Secret Mantra has hundreds of thousands of billions of great divine powers. If you have recited the summoning... but do not see death coming, then this dharma does not need to be done anymore, because even doing it would be in vain. So I immediately went down to court and told the homeowner:} {align:justify|– I cannot proceed with the transfer.} {align:justify|The homeowner asked:} {align:justify|– Is there anything wrong? Is it because there is not enough money?} {align:justify|– No! It's not a matter of money, but something very strange...} {align:justify|– What's strange?} {align:justify|I honestly say: It's because the atmosphere is very strange, the soul doesn't come, this is related to the spirit committing the great crime of adultery! That's why I personally have no way to perform the super-transmission ceremony!} {align:justify|The homeowner raised his voice:} {align:justify|– Are you talking funny yet? How could that be? Isn't that unreasonable? It's just a small kindness, but if you don't like doing it, just say no! There's no need to blame anything wildly: My child's fate, soul, and contempt for being sexually reprimanded like that? If you don't do it, we will ask someone else to do it! Is it a big deal?} {align:justify|I greeted the homeowner and friends at the scene and then sadly left.} {align:justify|I heard that that night the homeowner invited many famous groups to chant sutras, coordinated all performances with modern electronic instruments, creating a very bustling requiem ceremony. After that, the homeowner even said disparaging words and laughed at me.} {align:justify|I used to find it difficult to endure because of this transcendent ceremony, because I had already been on the throne but then fell down, and even said to the officiant: "I cannot perform this transcendent ceremony!"...} {align:justify|Honestly, even now I can't do it!… This is truly a rare thing, very rarely happens in my life!} {align:justify|It's definitely not because I'm overbearing and arrogant, just because I know too well: The ghost of Tu Bon don't come! If death does not come, how can I perform the act of transcendence? Since I couldn't see the ascended spirit with my own eyes, how could I say: This ceremony went well?…} {align:justify|I really wanted to find out where the soul of this guy Tu Bon was, so I took the trouble to go to the Tu Bon temple, determined to investigate thoroughly.} {align:justify|I asked the Tu Bon God:} {align:justify|– Where is Tu Bon's soul?} {align:justify|The Divine Emperor immediately checked and looked in the book and saw that there were no records (Please explain: There are two types of people who, after death, do not go through the certificate of records. One is: People who practice, are directly promoted, but this class is relatively rare. Second is: Great evil people, because they have to suffer a miserable retribution, so their soul and spirit form are all destroyed, called: "The spirit and form are destroyed" so there is no record).} {align:justify|I ask:} {align:justify|– So then Tu Bon has been promoted?} {align:justify|The tutelary god confirmed:} {align:justify|– Of course not.} {align:justify|– So... he has been "exterminated" by the "god"?} {align:justify|– This is completely possible!} {align:justify|The tutelary god said: Now, considering the cause of the crime: Murder is a great evil, adultery is a great poison, rape is extremely evil, it is inevitable that he will receive bad punishment. obviously.} {align:justify|I thank the Tutelary God for pointing this out. After returning to the hut, I thought about this forever. Clearly I saw the God of Kitchen God holding a white cloth, with the two words DEMOCRACY written on it, then it could be because of Tu Bon's sexual immorality that he was punished by the gods, all the spirits were punished...} {align:justify|I sat down to meditate, closed my eyes to observe, suddenly I saw a silver screen appear in front of my eyes, the scene was progressing clearly just like a film being shown:} {align:justify|The female maids were all persecuted and raped by Tu Bon, causing them to be corrupted and corrupted. The young people who were sexually promiscuous were in full swing, and there was nothing they could not commit. The more liberal, the more extravagant! Tu Bon did not hesitate to commit adultery in front of Kitchen God, so his crime was increased by one level! He wears lust like an animal, like a crazy person! Even in a pure Buddhist sect, you dare to dare to do dirty things and cause corruption to pure practitioners. This is an extremely evil act. This crime is a hundred times more serious, there is no escaping it, it seems that he has nothing evil to do!} {align:justify|Whenever he meets a beautiful woman, his mind is filled with lust, and he resorts to rape and coercion. When a beautiful woman resisted, it was better than death, so Tu Bon strangled, murdered, and raped them...} {align:justify|After raping the beautiful woman and killing her, he buried her body in the wilderness, without any remorse in his heart, even harming a girl from a good family.} {align:justify|During meditation, every word and every sentence of Tu Bon's accusation appeared extremely clearly on the screen, I watched in shock!} {align:justify|I understood clearly: Tu Bon's death was being punished by a Rakshasa demon. Unfortunately, he couldn't come during the funeral ceremony, that's the reason!} {align:justify|One day I was walking on the street, I happened to meet an old man, he hurriedly asked:} {align:justify|– Is that Master Lu?} {align:justify|– Yes!} {align:justify|– Don't you recognize me?} {align:justify|– It just looks familiar. Sorry, because I interact with hundreds of people every day, I can't remember at the moment...} {align:justify|The old man introduced himself:} {align:justify|– My last name is To, I am the butler of the billionaire Tu family, I took care of Tu Bon from childhood to adulthood. When the teacher performed the Resurrection Ceremony, I was also there.} {align:justify|– Ah! So that's it? I remember, I met him a few times, talked to him and told him how to arrange the altar... He doesn't lie and is straightforward, doesn't like to hide anything.} {align:justify|Then he lowered his voice and whispered in my ear:} {align:justify|– Regarding what Tu Bon did, we were very familiar with and understood all too well his bad and evil actions.So the story of him being beyond salvation is true, we all believe it. But as a salaryman of the Tu family, we don't dare to say...} {align:justify|Then he sighed and lamented:} {align:justify|-Tu had a great lust for evil, created earth-shattering evil, and thus had a short life and an unfortunate death.} {align:justify|The number of female servants of the Tu family was four, and the male butler was only me. One day, the old slave couldn't sleep, wanted to take a smoke, so he stood up and went to the garden, preparing a cigarette... when suddenly he witnessed Tu Bon committing evil acts, raping the maid...} {align:justify|And the maid named Tran was married and had a husband at home. Later, he was also sexually abused in the kitchen. It's even more unimaginable that he abused a total of four maids, Tu Bon did not spare anyone...} {align:justify|I said: He did not spare the nun and even raped the widow...} {align:justify|He listened to me, so scared that he was startled:} {align:justify|– How do you know everything so well?} {align:justify|I replied:} {align:justify|– If you want people not to know, then Don't do it!} {align:justify|Lao To said: Yes, I understand. Oh my! This arrogant and evil guy Tu Bon, he relied on his wealth to commit countless crimes, it's hard to count them all. If you do evil, you will receive evil retribution! If he doesn't know how to repent, how can he be saved?} {align:justify|The old butler shook his head and lamented... then he politely said goodbye to me and sadly walked away...}

She does not understand Buddhism, does not study Buddhism, but realizes that life and death in human life is a continuous cycle and is not scary.} {align:justify|She does not often chant, but she sees the realm of the dying person, and clearly understands the need to recite Buddha's name in order to help the deceased peacefully reincarnate. That: If you want to help people after death, the first thing to do is to invite monks from pagodas to perform the rebirth ceremony for them.} {align:justify|Miss Y was born with high enlightenment and wisdom, all of which stemmed from her pure and compassionate mind, not greedy for fame and fortune on earth. In the past, her family also had a monk in the Forbidden City who specialized in guiding royal monks.} {align:justify|She told me that one time, Mr. Tu was a relative of her friend who passed away. She came to visit. To avoid disturbing the bereaved family, she stood outside the hospital room.} {align:justify|The deceased's family was completely non-religious. Thế nhưng chị dâu ông Tú lại tin Phật, niệm Phật. So, regardless of family members stopping her, she resolutely entered the hospital room and recited Buddha's name to pray for the deceased.} {align:justify|Miss Y did not understand anything about Buddha, she just clasped her hands together and sincerely prayed for Mr. Tu to pass away safely. Perhaps the deceased's sister-in-law recited Buddha's prayers sincerely and was inspired, because Ms. Y clearly saw the scene of the deceased's amazing transformation. Right in the midst of her sister-in-law's resounding chants of Buddha's name, she saw the spirit fly out of his body from the hospital bed. His shape was transparent and light as smoke. He first flew up and stopped on the ceiling of the hospital room, looking for a long time at everything that was happening on his body. Finally, in front of him suddenly appeared a bright path rushing straight to the sky, so the spirit followed that spiral path filled with light, flying straight to the boundless universe...} {align:justify|Miss Y witnessed this situation with her own eyes and suddenly became enlightened, understanding that human death is not scary, because after death's door, a new life begins... Is it scary because the evil karma the deceased has created and must be taken with them. Therefore, when we live, we need to do all good things.Also, when holding a funeral for the dead, relatives must not kill and make offerings, but must make vegetarian offerings!} {align:justify|When a relative dies, relatives absolutely must not cry, because doing so will make the person lose their mind, be insecure, be entangled with attachment, and confuse their hearts, and if they start a disordered or wrong thought, they will fall...} {align:justify|She also told me, when her father-in-law passed away, she clearly saw his ghost flying up the wall of the room, so she immediately told her husband:} {align:justify|– Dad hasn't gone anywhere, he's still in this room.} {align:justify|A moment later her husband's death slowly flew out the window... she told me this experience and said: Death is actually continuing to be born, so there's nothing scary about death, if you always live a good life.} {align:justify|But in this scientific age, it's difficult to explain to people the story of death and the post-death realm that follows. That's because most people don't know what death is, they only know that as long as they live, they worry about fighting, winning, craving, eating delicious food... Because of this delusion, they create all kinds of crimes, bringing countless sufferings to the mind and body.} {align:justify|My Master has reminded us many times: Where do people's diseases such as: Cerebral thrombosis, AIDS, polio, stroke, cancer, neurological diseases... come from? It is caused by craving, it is caused by murder, religion, lust, delusion... manipulation.} {align:justify|In America, usually about two or three months before the patient is about to die, the doctor always clearly informs the patient of the situation so that they can conveniently handle everything while they are still alive and calmly welcome death.} {align:justify|And the majority of us Easterners, have never been educated like that, and do not have any understanding of birth and death. So every time a sick person passes away, the family members also perform scenes of crying and clinging... causing a great uproar, making the deceased even more bound by love and suffering. Not to mention the dangers caused by the bereaved family killing too many animals to make offerings... They are completely unaware that: Doing so will only cause the deceased's soul to fall into the evil realm, it will only be harmful to the deceased, and will not help anything at all.} {align:justify|So, if we love our family and friends, then we must tell them clearly about death while they are still alive, so that everyone, while still alive, knows how to prepare well for the moment of death: With our own accumulated good karma. And at the moment a loved one dies, you should not cry and make a fuss, disrupting their rebirth.} {align:justify|If you want to eliminate afflictions, end life and death, and attain Bodhi, you must practice. Everyone who practices can attain it. If you don't practice, you won't attain it. The most important thing for each person is life and death!}

tieu_de: 09. THE SPRING TOP WHERE THE STATUE OF THE GOVERNOR
tom_tat: Most of us strongly believe in Cause and Effect, because we have witnessed many thrilling cases that science cannot explain. Most of my colleagues in the car worship Buddha statues or wear...
noi_dung: {align:justify|Most of us believe in Cause and Effect, because we have witnessed many thrilling cases that science cannot explain. Most of my colleagues on the bus worship Buddha statues or wear protective mantras... Before departing, we often clasp our hands to recite Buddha's name and silently pray, this has become an unwritten rule. Beijing City, where I work, has had many very strange cases, it must be said that it is difficult to imagine.} {align:justify|First of all, I would like to introduce myself: I have been a police officer for 17 years, first I worked at the police station. After that, I was sent to Dai Hung, served at the police school for a year. When my superiors came to recruit special operations people, an experienced old police officer chose me. So he became my image master, and to this day we still work together} {align:justify|We are like father and son. My master is 52 years old this year, he has been a police officer for 35 years. He taught me many good things. Now I would like to tell you about a strange case, but please allow me to hide the person's name and address and replace it with an pseudonym.} {align:justify|First, let me tell you the story when I just arrived at the Police Department to work. At that time, in 1994, we received news that someone died near the newly opened theater. The reporter said that a fight broke out in front of the theater, causing death. But when we went to the scene to investigate, that wasn't the case!} {align:justify|The reason for the man's death was very strange: As soon as the victim entered the front door of the theater, his feet slipped and staggered, then he bumped into the tip of the spear on the more than one meter high statue of Quan Cong and was pierced in the pharynx by the tip of the spear, aiming right at the main artery. People around saw blood spurting out of his neck... they were all frightened, but no one dared to come closer, so the incident happened. Emergency treatment was delayed, causing the victim's death.} {align:justify|At that time, there were few people in the theater. At that time, in front of the theater was a very pompous place, where the door was specially decorated to worship a statue of Quan Cong holding a spear in his hand. This was also the cause of the strange case. We invited the director named Van Nguyen to the station for a long interrogation. My master asked him:} {align:justify|– If you do business, why do you worship the statue of Guan Gong?(Because most business people often worship statues of the God of Wealth. There is also a theory that Quan Cong is the God of Martial Arts - the God of Martial Arts and the God of Wealth).} {align:justify|The director said:} {align:justify|– This was given to me in advance by the singers, the statue had just been delivered that night...} {align:justify|We immediately found the director's friend who specializes in bronze work named Tu Hung, (He is the artist who made this spear) to interrogation. Only then did Tu Hung's family discover: he had been missing for three days, no one had seen him. Calling is also not possible. At that time, we had a hunch that something was definitely going on here.} {align:justify|We quickly went back to find the director to ask about Tu Hung's relationship. Van Nguyen said that he and Hung were just business friends. At this point, he suddenly remembered: Two days ago at the pub, Hung expressed his desire to buy a car, the director told Hung: It will cost a lot of money!} {align:justify|But Hung seemed very interested in buying, and happily said: After buying a new car, he will let the director test drive it. Van Nguyen heard him speak and whispered, thinking this was just a joke while drinking, so he just smiled without paying attention.} {align:justify|We heard this and immediately asked the director: Does he have any other business? Do you normally like to spend a lot of money?} {align:justify|Van Nguyen replied: oh well, Tu Hung's personality is not only stingy but also cowardly. Even though he works in the field and has a few thousand in his hand, if he wants to buy a car, the money is still not enough.} {align:justify|After two weeks of investigating Tu Hung, we discovered that the thirty thousand dollars he kept in his house had disappeared, and we also learned that he had bragged to many friends that he wanted to buy a car. Recently, he cooperated with a construction friend to earn a lot of money. Moreover, this construction worker has recently stopped by his lover's house to drink alcohol.} {align:justify|During that time, the Tay La Vien Police Department reported that they recovered a decomposed human head in the Tay La Vien river. Through forensic and criminal investigation, it was discovered that this was Tu Hung's head. He was beheaded by the killer with a hammer. The Tay La Vien river was just the place where the killer threw the head. dispossession.} {align:justify|We immediately sent people to find Tu Hung's lover named My Le. After going through a lot of trouble, we found her hiding in the countryside of Ha Nam, and invited her back to Beijing for questioning.} {align:justify|That night, My Le declared: She and Tu Hung had known each other for more than two months, one day he brought home a 30-year-old construction worker named Sang, from the Northeast. During the drinking party, Tu Hung kept boasting that he wanted to buy a car. Afterwards, Sang alone went to My Le's house and asked where the money Tu Hung wanted to buy the car was kept. My Le said it is currently stored in his house. After that, he visited My Le's house several times, was discovered by Tu Hung, and a fight broke out between Sang and Hung.} {align:justify|When Sang left, one time he came back to find My Le, asking her to cooperate with him to kill Hung, take the money and take them back to Hei Long Giang to live, so no one would find out. The two discussed the plan on how to kill Hung.} {align:justify|Then Sang told My Le to first give him the house key, then try to get Hung drunk, after which he would attack. At night, the two did as planned. Sang took advantage of Hung's drunkenness and took out the key to open the door himself. Tu Hung heard the noise and immediately turned his head to look, but Sang used a hammer to slash him. Hung's body was buried by them under a tree in the garden.} {align:justify|We immediately hunted for the murderer. After searching for a while, we discovered that Sang was the victim who fell three weeks ago, hit his neck on a spear, and died right in front of the theater.} {align:justify|At this point everyone understands the source. Everyone said: Because Sang was the murderer, he was avenged by Tu Hung's soul. he caused Sang to die under a spear he made with his own hands. The details of the case are truly thrilling beyond imagination, proving that Cause and Effect retribution appears very quickly and is not false.} {align:justify|I tell this story in the hope that readers will believe in Cause and Effect: Whatever you do, whatever you do... you must be extremely careful and do not hurt others.}

tom_tat: This is a true story that I personally experienced, no lies. Our family is not well-off, we used to live very hard, it seemed difficult to buy a house. After that, I learned about Buddhism, old...

The staff were all packing up to leave. Mom didn't have any hope left. She just randomly pulled a lottery out of the box and unexpectedly won... the best house in the neighborhood. Xem như gia đình mình… buồn ngủ gặp chiếu manh, cùng đường gặp lối thoát!} {align:justify|– Cha mẹ tôi báo tin với vẻ sướng vui vạn phần.} {align:justify|Tôi không ngạc nhiên, bởi vì tôi mơ hồ có linh cảm rất tốt lành, luôn cứ nghĩ là không cần phải lo, tôi cũng không rõ là tại sao mình lại có tư tưởng như vậy? Cho dù bị người tính toán, khi dễ, ăn hiếp… thì tôi cũng không bao giờ cho phép mình được phản ứng tệ.} {align:justify|Ngay cả lúc niệm Phật, tụng kinh, cũng không nên mang tâm hám lợi, hướng Phật Bồ tát cầu xin này nọ… mà chỉ nên hành trì bằng tâm thanh tịnh, vô tạp niệm. Only then is it called understanding Buddha Dharma. Only then can the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas communicate with each other and be naturally blessed.} {align:justify|The reason why our whole family is lucky is because we all always: Vow to live kindly, honestly, never calculating with others, even if we encounter injustice, we vow to be patient, live without tricks to gain profit... perhaps thanks to that, blessings come. Also, I think regularly reciting the Heart Sutra and the Great Compassion Mantra to control the indifferent mind also helps attract good luck.}

tieu_de: 11. THE GREAT MASTER VISITS THE DISEASE
tom_tat: This true story happened in early 1990. At the beginning of this year, Director Truong suddenly fell ill with a strange illness. He suddenly had a cold, a terrible cold that made his head dizzy, in the summer of June...
noi_dung: {align:justify|This true story happened in early 1990.} {align:justify|Director Truong suddenly fell ill with a strange illness at the beginning of this year. He suddenly shivered, was so cold that his head was dizzy, and in the summer of June he had to wear cotton clothes. Since suffering from this strange illness, his face was pale, his whole body was damp, and he had no strength left, so he had to recuperate at home.} {align:justify|For the past two years, he went to all famous hospitals for diagnosis, but nowhere could he find the disease. Having spent tens of millions, but the cause of the disease could not be found, there was no cure.} {align:justify|Recently, a relative introduced that there was a great master with great supernatural powers who was good at treating diseases. Even though the hospitals were at a loss, he was able to cure it.} {align:justify|Director Truong did not believe it, at first he refused, refused to go to the doctor, then because of his relatives' constant advice, he had to listen, he also wanted to try, maybe he could meet a doctor. Or, it can be cured.} {align:justify|When the Great Master arrived, Director Truong was lying in bed. On a summer day in May, he was so cold that his teeth were chattering. The great master looks young, about 50 years old, with a simple, kind, and pure appearance. The Master only glanced at Mr. Truong, and he was trembling, looking extremely scared. I've been waiting for the bride for so long, and finally we can meet!} {align:justify|I told that country ghost:} {align:justify|– The past cannot be grasped, the old things have passed, and can never come back. Qua Tinh is currently a disciple of Buddha, and is married to someone, so don't be disrespectful.} {align:justify|General Ly Mat and the demon kings of Dharma Protectors immediately took all the water demons away from Qua Tinh.} {align:justify|Qua Tinh and I immediately invited General Ly Mat to guide everyone in reciting Buddha's name. Following the sound "Namo Amitabha Buddha", Qua Tinh saw:Behind General Ly Mat, there are many Sentient Beings coming continuously, they are lined up in an endless line, including the general's subordinates and the slain Sentient Beings in addition to the "General's Cave", there are also wild ghosts and ghosts in the area, they all imitate Buddha's chanting, there are many Sentient Beings with ugly appearances, now transformed into dignified ones again, and there are also some mature Sentient Beings, under the blessings of Buddha's power. be freed from the evil path, reincarnated into the realm of human, heavenly or good path... practice.} {align:justify|From then on, General Ly Mat came to Bodhimanda at any time to listen to the sutras and preach the Dharma, practiced diligently, and after only a few days, through Qua Tinh, asked her to call me to convey Ly Mat's questions as follows:} {align:justify|– I am loved by the people of Ha Quan, now I have a few things to ask of you:} {align:justify|One: Because I am now a disciple of Buddha, I cannot eat meat or kill animals; I hope the two Lay Buddhists will quickly find a way to inform all the people of "General Dong" and Ha Quan that they absolutely should not bring flesh and blood to Sentient Beings to worship me anymore, please change the entire Chapter ceremony to vegetarian food, otherwise, there will be no blessings but disaster! As for me, I am also guilty and suffering because of this calamity of killing. Animals were once human, so killing them is no different from killing people. If you sacrifice their flesh and blood to the gods, it is impossible, because they are also the people of the gods.} {align:justify|Two: Please warn the world's people on my behalf: Sin and blessings are clear, Cause and Effect are retribution, the six paths of reincarnation... are absolutely not false. I have now found the great path of light, completely leaving suffering to be happy, escaping the six paths of reincarnation, that is Buddha Dharma. So I also hope that people will know how to put an end to evil and cultivate good deeds, diligently practice and study Buddhism, and achieve mutual benefits.} {align:justify|I also vow to join the ranks of the Thien Long Dharma Protectors of the Eight Orders, vowing to support all those who study Buddhism to practice good deeds. Everyone must know: If you practice good deeds, then the blessings will come naturally, there is no need to work hard to kill Sentient Beings and sacrifice to the gods, to pray for blessings to save suffering and bring joy... Because the nature of the Good Spirit is: Always bless and bless those who do good deeds.} {align:justify|Listening to what he said, I praised his kindness and respectfully responded to General Ly Mat's entrustment. What General Ly Mat entrusted is very important and meaningful.} {align:justify|Food is a big problem that demons and gods always have to face. In Buddhism, there are precise chanting rituals that support the giving of pure food to ghosts and spirits such as: The Sutra "Buddha's Teaching to Save Da La Ni, Mong Son Thi Thuc", etc., so it is necessary to widely spread and introduce the Cause and Effect principle. This is the necessary foundation for entering the study of Buddhism.} {align:justify|After that, I contacted the local management board of "General Quan Dong" many times, but still could not successfully contact, and because the staff was too busy, there was no way to go to Yunnan Dali to take care of this matter.} {align:justify|Recently, Qua Tinh saw General Ly Mat several times. He was worried because of our unfinished business, he complained: It's been almost a year. Nowadays, there are many people killing animals brought to worship "General Quan Dong", creating more karma that will implicate his purification, causing more injustice. I am afraid that in the future it will be difficult for him to avoid falling into the animal world to repay his life debt. He urged me to quickly think of a way to fulfill his wish to help him. I also felt that this matter could not be planned forever, so I had to write this story down in writing, hoping that Buddhists and tourists in Yunnan, after reading this article, would take what General Ly Mat entrusted, circulate it, and inform the native people of "General Dong". At the same time, I hope this brings good Dharma Talk to people, causing them to completely abandon the practice of cruelly killing animals. Please advise all people in the world: Do not use flesh and blood of Sentient Beings to sacrifice to gods and the deceased!} {align:justify|In the Ksitigarbha Sutra, it is said: Please advise Sentient Beings to be careful on the day of death, do not kill and create evil, or sacrifice to demons... Why? Because killing and offering does not bring any merit or benefit to themselves or the deceased, on the contrary, it makes the crime worse. If the deceased deserves to be born in the human world, or attain sainthood, because of being killed and offered by relatives at the end of their lives, they will be affected by suffering, so they will be slow to be born in the good world.What's more, when a person is about to die, he has never done good things in his life and must follow bad karma into the evil realm. Why do his relatives still callously kill him, causing them to increase their suffering? Ksitigarbha Sutra has kindly reminded us, we must keep it in mind.} {align:justify|The Divine King Ly Mat Quits the Three Jewels} {align:justify|The old lam Bodhisattva is now increased} {align:justify|The Dharma Protector earnestly calls out} {align:justify|Please use vegetarian food!} {align:justify|Praying for the merit of this article, praying for General Ly Mat and his subordinates, and the animals that were killed, along with all Sentient Beings in the six paths... all receive pure food, are full and satisfied, leave suffering and are happy, believe in Buddha's teachings, are reborn in the Pure Land, and practice Bodhi!} {align:justify|Reflecting on the Fruit Pillar - May 23, 2012} {align:justify|Explanation: Ly Mat was born in 582 and died in 619, at the age of 37. From the year he died to the time he took refuge in the Three Jewels in 2011, he and his subordinates had gone through 1,639 years.}

tieu_de: 04. REVEALING THE PAST, REPENTING FOR OLD MISTAKES
tom_tat: In July 2012, under the blessings of Buddha's power, a wise practitioner who happened to come to their house to attend a great ceremony to pray for the deceased and stay for three days discovered the answer. After the grand ceremony...
noi_dung: {align:justify|In July 2012, under the blessings of Buddha, a wise practitioner happened to come to their house to attend the ceremony to pray for the deceased and stay for three days, under the blessings of Buddha.} {align:justify|After the ceremony was completed, everyone sat and chatted, the wise person suddenly fell silent, looking intently at Ms. asked:} {align:justify|– Why do you look so strange, have you seen through my past life?} {align:justify|This person solemnly nodded and replied:} {align:justify|– I saw an army camp in ancient times, the marshal was very majestic and handsome. IT'S YOU!... stationed there!} {align:justify|Master Trinh Ba Duc heard that and immediately asked:} {align:justify|– What do you see on this marshal's flag?} {align:justify|– Oh! I saw it, it's the word "Chu"!} {align:justify|The last name "Chu"? – We were thinking the same thing, so which dynasty does this general "Chu" belong to?…} {align:justify|The wise man closed his eyes for a moment and said:} {align:justify|– I saw you: A young man who looked very powerful and handsome, everyone around called her Admiral”…} {align:justify|– Admiral? – We asked in unison, looking at each other hesitantly…} {align:justify|– Yes! Miss is Admiral Chu Du of the state of Wu during the Three Kingdoms period. Her mother, General Hoang Cai, was famous for his miserable... Because she knew how to practice Buddhism, things could still be saved. She understood why she suffered from many illnesses and found the answer. Thanks to that, her illness was eliminated. The stronger your faith, the better results you will get.} {align:justify|This is everything I witnessed and wrote honestly, you can't believe it. tom_tat: On June 25, 2011, some Buddhists and I attended the rebirth dharma conference at Thuy Phong pagoda (Cuu Hoa mountain) to pray for all Sentient Beings who died due to war, natural disasters, and calamities. When everyone...
noi_dung: {align:justify|On June 25, 2011, some Buddhists and I attended the Dharma Assembly at Thuy Phong Pagoda (Cuu Hoa Mountain) to pray for all Sentient Beings who died due to war, natural disasters, and calamities.} {align:justify|When everyone left Lion Roaring Hall, suddenly we heard a Dharma friend say: Today someone brought a newly purchased pair of old turtles to the pagoda to release them!} {align:justify|I heard that These two turtles have lived for hundreds of years and are currently kept at the Ksitigarbha Palace. We invited each other to visit together. So everyone went to Ksitigarbha Palace. Seeing these two turtles about 70cm long, weighing several hundred kilograms, lying still on the ground.} {align:justify|Everyone chanted refuge for them three times, then said:} {align:justify|– The two of them need to repent, turn to evil and turn to good, strive to practice well, sincerely vow that in the future they will leave suffering and be happy, abandon the body of animals, be born in the Western world of ultimate bliss, escape the six paths of samsara...} {align:justify|One rang up:} {align:justify|– Everyone watched, the turtle nodded!} {align:justify|Everyone looked... saw the biggest turtle, which had been retracting its head in its shell, now poking out, repeatedly nodding to the Buddha, as if paying respects... and also showing an attitude as if it had heard and understood what everyone was saying.} {align:justify|Qua Tinh also came from Sichuan to participate in the Dharma conference, ready for her to tell everyone. Listen to the Cause and Effect of these two turtles:} {align:justify|The biggest turtle is a male turtle, who in his previous life was a monk. In one life in India, he was originally a monk, but only knew how to cultivate blessings, create goodness, and was very fond of releasing lives, so he liberated countless lives and accumulated many blessings... But because he did not clearly understand: Practicing must have the desire to escape birth and death, he was only interested in cultivating blessings and not cultivating wisdom, so his heart was still full of greed, anger, ignorance, and afflictions... As a result, he was unable to free himself from birth and death, and in the next life, thanks to the blessings that had created him, he was born as a rich man, living in ignorance again. Infatuated, he indulged in enjoyment, completely forgot about practice, and spent his whole life wholeheartedly enjoying the five desires.} {align:justify|In his next life, he was born as a boatman taking people across the river, and was controlled by greed, so he saw that beauty and talent were infatuated, and his reason was clouded. It recruits many scoundrels who gather together to do evil.Whenever they see guests carrying a lot of money, luggage, etc., they wait until the boat reaches the middle of the river, take all their belongings, push people into the river, and drown them. And whenever they see beautiful girls, they drug them to make them unconscious and rape them, then sell the victims to brothels for money to spend.} {align:justify|Because in the past this turtle has created boundless evil karma, it is true that he has committed a serious crime and must fall into hell, but thanks to having created blessings in the past, the good results have not yet been enjoyed, so after death he was only reincarnated into the animal world, born as a black turtle. He is able to live a long life thanks to the release of countless species in the past, and the blessings should continue to be enjoyed... It's just a pity that due to ignorance and greed and anger, he acted crazy, so now with the body of an animal, he can only enjoy the blessing of longevity.} {align:justify|And the smaller turtle lying next to him is his wife in previous lives. Because when the husband does evil, the wife also rejoices and happily consumes money illegally, happily enjoying together, not knowing how to stop but always admiring and praising the evil deeds her husband does. Because of that common karma, they were also born in the animal world, living together. Cause and Effect are not at all wrong, today the person who saved them from the hands of the butcher and brought them here to release them is someone who was released by them in a previous life. Now they have come to Bodhimanda Ksitigarbha, heard the Buddha's teachings and the cause of their fall, they have remembered the events, and are now shedding tears... crying and repenting for their past sins!} {align:justify|Obviously the pair of turtles were crying, of course I saw it. I even bowed low to observe more clearly. To be exact, the pair of turtles kept shedding tears. Their eyes are blurry, wet... A Dharma friend doubtfully asked:} {align:justify|– Heard science says: Sea turtles and water turtles can cry, both to eliminate salt and to help refresh their eyes, is that right?} {align:justify|Qua Tinh said:} {align:justify|– That's right! But right now they're not crying because of this situation, they're crying: It's because they're too emotional! Because I saw the two turtles' eyes showing sadness... they looked like an ancient couple!Indeed, they are sad and crying, not only do they regret the mistakes they made in the past, but they also remember their children and relatives who are separated...} {align:justify|So it turned out that, everyone gathered together to comfort the pair of turtles, suddenly Qua Tinh told me: Old turtle has something to say. He asked: You all advised him to pray for rebirth in the Pure Land in the future, but he had never heard of this place before. He wanted to know what this area was like? Is it good to go there?} {align:justify|Qua Tinh told me: I'm not very good at explaining the sutras, please explain Buddhism to them so they can understand clearly.} {align:justify|I then preached the general idea: "Buddha preaches the Amitabha Sutra" to them, then based on that explained the Western Pure Land is a place where good people live together, have an endless lifespan, a dignified realm, practice without turning back, and will definitely attain supreme Buddhahood... The two turtles listened attentively and nodded continuously.} {align:justify|On the afternoon of the 26th day the Dharma meeting ended, we reluctantly said goodbye to the monastery. The story of the pair of turtles made everyone excited and excited... because they saw that the three worlds are like a house on fire, reincarnation is suffering, the human body is precious, if afflictions are not eliminated, they will definitely be reincarnated into a lower realm... Therefore, they all vow: In this life, do not be attached to samsara, seek birth in the Pure Land, say goodbye to birth and death.} {align:justify|All Sentient Beings have enough Buddha nature, but ignorance covers their original minds. Please advise everyone not to let time pass in vain, diligently practice for liberation to escape from birth and death.} {align:justify|Pray that all Sentient Beings will believe in the Buddha Dharma, know how to cherish life, eliminate killing, stop evil and do good, realize Buddha's principles, and practice diligently to soon attain Bodhi.}

tom_tat: The first time we met, I saw Brother Ma releasing birds in the Buddha Recitation Hall with another Dharma friend. Brother Ma is currently over 40 years old, is a typical Shandong great man, his appearance is similar to the character Vo...
noi_dung: {align:justify|The first time we met, I saw Brother Ma releasing birds in the Buddhist Recitation Hall with another Dharma friend.} {align:justify|Brother Ma is currently over 40 years old, a typical Shandong great man, with an appearance similar to the character Vo Tong fighting a tiger in the story Water Margin.} {align:justify|He has thick eyebrows and big eyes, a strong physique, a generous personality, a voice like a ringing bell, a strong inner force, and looks very majestic and aura. So.} {align:justify|The story of brother Ma's practice is also tricky and thrilling... we can use the phrase "romantic in the beginning" to describe it. He practiced martial arts since childhood, then joined the army, his body was very muscular and fit.} {align:justify|After being discharged, he stayed at home. While practicing martial arts, some brothers came to find him and gradually formed a gang of gangsters. Hoan Dai district is famous as a place of entertainment, with many dance halls, theaters, bars, bars, etc. Wherever forms of entertainment, fighting, etc. are more prevalent, the gangster force is stronger.} {align:justify|Brother Ma is very good at martial arts and intelligent and clever. After many competitions, he quickly achieved the "kingdom" and became famous in the gangster world. He established his own party, became the boss of a realm, his power became stronger and stronger, his career also developed equally, he had many disciples and subordinates, he was very majestic and courageous.} {align:justify|One day in 2003, he went to Dai Tap street, Hoan Dai district for a walk, and happened to see an old man selling statues of Guan Yin. He did not know the material of the statue, but as soon as he looked at it, he was very happy. So he approached and asked for the price, who hesitated to pay 180 VND! He found it too expensive so he left.} {align:justify|A month later, when he continued walking around, he also met that old man. This time he lowered the price to 100 dong, but he still found it expensive, so he refused to buy it.} {align:justify|He himself was a gangster, holding the power of life and death in his hands. Normally, if he wanted it, he would have raped it a long time ago, but this was the Guan Yin statue, so he did not dare to act arrogantly.} {align:justify|After half a month, he went out and met that old man again. Seeing that the Avalokitesvara statue has not been sold yet. This time, without waiting for him to ask, the old man automatically opened his mouth:} {align:justify|– Looks like this Buddha statue and you have a bad relationship, well, I'll only charge 60 dong, consider it both a sale and a gift!} {align:justify|Hearing that, he immediately took out the money to pay, then brought the statue home and placed it on the table in his bedroom, then sat and looked at it back and forth, feeling very happy.} {align:justify|One night, after getting extremely drunk, as soon as he got home, he fell asleep. At about 4:00 a.m., he woke up to drink water, saw the statue of Guan Yin on the table, and suddenly a strange thought occurred to him: "I heard that Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara saves people from suffering and is incredibly spiritually inspired. I wonder if this is true?... If it is true, then today please Bodhisattva manifest his spirit and let me see it clearly so that I can believe it!"... (he was originally an atheist, had never known how to bow down and bow to anyone, he did not believe in the Cause and Effect theories or whether there were any). But in the past, when he practiced martial arts, he often sat still, but that was just practicing qigong)...} {align:justify|He had just bowed like that, thought to himself and smiled, then went back to bed, but couldn't sleep...} {align:justify|While closing his eyes and dreaming, suddenly he saw the Bodhisattva Bodhisattva as if it was emitting light, the light was bright yellow but radiated very gently, he looked at the golden light. sparkling in his heart, feeling extremely comfortable... Suddenly he was startled awake, he no longer saw the Bodhisattva emitting light, but every time he closed his eyes, he saw the Bodhisattva emitting light again...} {align:justify|He began to doubt: "Maybe I drank too much alcohol that caused that hallucination!"... But clearly the Bodhisattva statue was smiling, he saw His face, his eyes... very clearly. So he couldn't sleep.} {align:justify|The next morning, early in the morning, he quickly went out to learn about Buddhism. After asking a few friends, he found out that there was Kim Lang Pagoda nearby, so he immediately went there.} {align:justify|This was his first time going to the pagoda. He went around and paid his respects in front of each temple, but didn't see anything miraculously inspired. He couldn't help but feel depressed... Seeing the bunch of Cause and Effect retribution books (the pagoda) to read for free to get married), he immediately asked for a few books to take home to read... This was the first time he came into contact with religion, the more he read, the more he liked it, the more he looked, the more scared he became...} {align:justify|He thought he had done bad things all these years, and in his heart he began to regret and panic. Thanks to reading the Cause and Effect retribution stories in the book, he understood that all the bad karma he had created were crimes worthy of hell...} {align:justify|After reading the good books, Brother Ma meditated a lot, and then a change occurred in his heart. Since then, he has improved a lot and is no longer aggressive and fierce. But as a member of the gangster world, everything was not decided by himself, he had to often participate in the affairs of the dark party, just from then on he recited Buddha's name, worshiped Buddha...} {align:justify|Next, he also invited a picture of "Avalokitesvara riding on a black dragon" to hang on the living room wall. Then, feeling excited, he went to the statue and bowed his head a few times...} {align:justify|Until one autumn night in 2008...} {align:justify|That night he came home, around eight or nine o'clock. As soon as he entered the house, he saw Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara (in the picture hanging in the living room walking out, standing in the air looking down at him). Brother Ma was startled, quickly knelt down, bowed his head like a star, and shouted loudly for his wife to come out and see. When his wife ran out, there was nothing left. He raised his head to see the Bodhisattva in the air had also disappeared...} {align:justify|This time he was very alert, one hundred percent positive that his eyes saw clearly and was not an illusion. Because he had seen Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara with his own eyes, his spirit was engraved into his bones, this emotional feeling seemed to penetrate his whole body...} {align:justify|This time, he was convinced and thoroughly repented. In the morning, when I went to the grave to make offerings, I offered alms, recited the Six Syllable Dai Minh mantra and recited the Dedication of Merit mantra seven times for my grandfather and the Nine Mystic Seven Patriarchs.} {align:justify|Around May, one night I dreamed of my grandfather. He didn't say anything to me, just used an iron pen to write down his name.} {align:justify|The next morning, I went to visit my grandmother and asked her if my grandfather's name was To Tuan An...? She was surprised and asked: How did you know?} {align:justify|At that time I was very emotional, so it was true that my grandfather had given me a dream.} {align:justify|I asked again:} {align:justify|– Is my grandfather a medium-sized figure, about one meter sixty-five tall, slightly high cheekbones, likes to wear ash-gray leader's clothes, and his left pocket often holds an iron pen, right?} {align:justify|Grandma replied: Yes so!} {align:justify|I was extremely surprised. You must know, when I was one year old, my grandfather passed away, so I was completely unaware of his physique, but this image I saw of him in my dream, and after asking my grandmother, it was completely consistent. At that time, my grandmother was muttering:} {align:justify|– What is wrong with this Old Man to harass that little girl?} {align:justify|Knowing my grandfather's name, I asked Ms. Bat Ngu and Ms. Tieu Dao to help me make a shrine for him. When I went to Nam Son Temple to attend the Buddha's retreat, I also solemnly made the Resurrection Tablet for my grandfather.} {align:justify|During this year, thanks to my participation in the Lotus Sutra group to study Buddhism, I understood a lot. Gradually my faith in Uncle Dai Bi arose, I began to recite the Great Compassion Mantra, because I heard: Reciting 108 times a day plus three repetitions of the Heart Sutra, can very miraculously transcend the deceased.} {align:justify|From then on. I specialize in reciting the Great Compassion Mantra and reciting the Heart Sutra for the Dedication of Merit for my grandfather. During that time, I also spent several thousand to release animals and offer food to him. One time, he even recited the Ksitigarbha sutra to pray for him.} {align:justify|In October, after returning from Nam Son Tu, I dreamed of my grandfather again. He no longer looked sad and depressed like before, but was dressed very beautifully, solemnly, with a bright face, he looked at me and smiled happily.} {align:justify|From then on, I no longer dreamed of my grandfather, I knew he had passed away in a good land.}

noi_dung: {align:justify|Mr. Hu Van is a holy monk with noble speech and actions. His life had many mysterious things, when he visited Ke Tuc mountain, the bell rang by itself, when he went to Cao Danh pagoda, fairy orchids radiated a sweet fragrance, when he preached sutras, dry trees came back to life, apricot flowers bloomed lotuses, vegetables in the garden bloomed lotus flowers, even all the candles lit in Bodhimanda bloomed in lotus shapes. If you pray for rain, you will receive rain, if you pray for snow, you will receive snow. Whatever you intend to do, you will have an underground god supporting you: help move rocks, fill rivers... When he is forced to cut down old trees, the fallen tree will also choose a peaceful direction for the pagoda. When the Japanese bombed his pagoda, the bomb fell in a deserted area. No one was killed, but the Japanese plane died and broke up. Nhat was so scared that after that, whenever he had to fly, he took a detour and did not dare to fly over his temple. Any animal that He takes refuge in immediately becomes a vegetarian, and its aggressive and aggressive nature suddenly turns into gentleness. Cows also came to Him for help, tigers also knew how to seek Him for precepts... Tho gods and Dragon Kings all transformed into human beings to come and seek precepts...} {align:justify|In the beginning, at the age of 43, He made a conscious effort to pay homage to Ngu Dai Mountain, bowing in three steps, worshiping Manjushri all the way from South to North to pray for his mother's favor, it took almost three years to arrive. What is worth mentioning is that in the middle of the journey, he became seriously ill and almost died, causing Bodhisattva Manjushri to "bear it unbearably" and have to come down to earth as a beggar to save the day, carry things, cook, and help him...} {align:justify|Below is a fascinating anecdote about his visit to the mountain (at this time he was probably nearly a hundred years old, told by his disciples), which I was fortunate enough to read, and would like to share this blessing with the readers:} {align:justify|TIME TIMES WITH MR. HU VAN} {align:justify|The other day, at Nhan Si mountain in Xuyen Bac, we met a group of monkeys. We don't know if they were kind-hearted or curious, but a few of them climbed up trees to pick fruits and threw them down, and when we approached to pick up the fruit, we saw a very large monkey that looked like a king monkey, calling and reaching out its hands Hu Van explained:} {align:justify|You see, it wants us to stretch the bag to catch it. We quickly opened the bag, and the monkeys on the tree immediately picked the fruit and threw it down. They picked all the delicious ones.When we eat fruit, they look down from the tree and make noises, looking very happy. Venerable Hu Van said: It's so cute!} {align:justify|But this is not strange, because after that we also encountered more thrilling things, during the journey with Venerable Hu Van.} {align:justify|Bridge over the abyss} {align:justify|One day, we were walking on Vinh Phong mountain and got lost on the same road. Because in front was an abyss more than ten meters wide, looking down it was so deep that you couldn't see the bottom, it seemed impossible to get to the opposite shore. At this time, it was getting dark and there was nothing we could do, so we had to sit down and meditate, starting the retreat, preparing to spend the night here.} {align:justify|At that moment a hurricane arose, when the wind calmed down, suddenly we saw a giant beam appear on the other side of the mountain, nearly half a meter across, with its mouth open as wide as a basin. Master told me:} {align:justify|– Thanh An, we can go through the abyss!} {align:justify|At this moment I saw the great python, its mouth wide open, its tongue lolling, its eyes blinking, its head facing us nodding, I was scared out of my wits, when I thought of it eating me, I turned back and said to the Master:} {align:justify|– Are you joking with me, are you sure it won't eat us?} {align:justify|Venerable Hu Van smiled and said:} {align:justify|– Don't afraid, that's the Bodhisattva who sent it to help us!} {align:justify|The master saw that I was still afraid, he told me to close my eyes and took my hand to lead me away. I squinted my eyes and saw the scene of the giant snake stretching its head over the abyss and lying down like a bridging position. Venerable Hu Van walked over first, I also followed, it felt like stepping on a large, elastic bridge. Finally, we crossed the opposite shore, only to discover that this python was much longer than expected, because I couldn't see where its tail was.} {align:justify|After crossing the shore, Venerable Hu Van immediately sat down and chanted sutras. A wind arose, when we opened our eyes, we could no longer see the python.} {align:justify|Continue to go about a thousand miles (one kilometer), then we came to a village, named Tay Tieu Thon, there were eighty households living here, we stayed for three days.} {align:justify|Warmth in the middle of the forest} {align:justify|Còn một lần nữa, khi chúng tôi đi vào vùng sơn lâm nguyên thủy, núi này có tên là Hổ Khâu Sơn…} {align:justify|Thì bỗng dưng khí trời thay đổi, gió bụi nổi lên mịt mù, trời càng lúc càng tối. There are no villages in front of this place, and no shops in the back. There was only the sound of the wind rushing. Một lát sau, mưa trút xuống ào ạt, băng đá rơi đầy, một hồi sau mới tạnh.} {align:justify|Cơn mưa lớn qua rồi, khắp nơi ẩm ướt, đường trơn trợt, trời mỗi lúc một tối, thế là chúng tôi đành trú ngụ tại đây. I went to get water and some firewood to make a fire to cook water. Because we were all dressed simply, and a heavy rain fell, our whole bodies were wet and cold. I was boiling water and blowing fire, when suddenly I heard a loud tiger roar. Only heard the sound but did not see the tiger. But a roar was raised and several other roars responded and responded, it seemed that there was not only one tiger!} {align:justify|Master saw the change in my face and immediately said:} {align:justify|– You're cowardly again! If our lives are not over then we will live. If our lives are over then we will be food for the tiger. Con hãy tới gần đây nương vào ta này, như vậy con sẽ không sợ nữa!} {align:justify|Do chúng tôi quá ngọ không ăn, giờ đành uống nước nóng lót dạ và ngồi tựa vào nhau.} {align:justify|Tôi khi đó còn nhỏ lắm, bởi đi đường quá mệt, nên chốc lát là ngủ say. At midnight, I felt warmer and warmer. As soon as I opened my eyes... Oh my god! There are currently six huge tigers surrounding us. Đã vậy Hòa thượng Hư Vân còn đưa tay vuốt ve đầu con hổ chúa to nhất nữa chứ.} {align:justify|Lúc này đầu óc tôi thật sự hoang mang, vì không biết mình đang mơ hay là tỉnh? Could it be that I am seeing the scene of “Tiger serving Arhat”? Three times I tried to stand up, but Master stopped me from standing up, telling me to quickly recite the sutras and calm my mind. Được một lát, tôi lại thiếp đi.} {align:justify|Trời sáng, khi tôi thức dậy, Sư phụ cười bảo:} {align:justify|– Đêm qua con sợ lắm hả? Là Sơn thần đến thăm đấy.} {align:justify|Đón và đưa} {align:justify|Ở Ngũ Đài Sơn có một câu châm ngôn: Bồ tát đối với người hữu duyên thì… “Xa tiếp tám trăm, tiễn đến ngàn dặm” đương nhiên chung quanh Ngũ Đài Sơn khoảng tám trăm dặm không hề có thổ phỉ.} {align:justify|That day we were stopping to rest, sitting and chatting. Venerable Hu Van explained to me what had happened. He said: At that time we did not meet a python, but a dragon. And when we are in the mountains, the species we encounter is not a tiger, but a leopard. You see, when we get close to Ngu Dai Mountain, someone will welcome us.} {align:justify|It was foggy that day, Master had a bit of a headache, we rested a bit then went up the mountain again.} {align:justify|Halfway up the mountain, we suddenly saw a bright light ahead, like an electric light, Venerable Hu Van immediately told us to quickly kneel down and pay our respects. At this time, we saw Bodhisattva Manjushri appearing on the mountainside, holding a whisk in his hand and waving it, as if he wanted to say something. This scene lasted for five minutes. Indeed, Bodhisattva Manjushri appeared to welcome us. This made us happy, our whole body seemed to gain strength. I walked several kilometers all day, didn't eat lunch, but now I'm not hungry. At night we arrived at Ha Phong Pagoda and stayed here for two days.} {align:justify|After that, we left, about thirty miles away from Ngu Dai, when we saw the mountainside suddenly lit up with Buddha light. An old lady came down from above and asked us from afar:} {align:justify|– Are you tired?} {align:justify|It was autumn, the old woman took out a few large almonds from the basket and gave them to the four of them. me.} {align:justify|She said: If you eat the first fruit, you won't be hungry, if you eat the second fruit, you won't be thirsty, if you eat the third fruit, you won't be tired, if you eat the fourth fruit, your whole body will feel light and relaxed. After I received the almond, I looked back and could no longer see the old woman.} {align:justify|At this point we realized: This must be Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara who helped us. Because it was autumn, how could there be almonds in the fall? But we clearly have almonds in our hands. After eating this almond, I didn't feel thirsty or hungry for several days, and my spirit was extremely good.} {align:justify|These are rare and unforgettable memories of the times we visited the mountain with Venerable Hu Van.}
